verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents its own parallel-execution capacity: projects get 10 concurrent cloud browsers by default, scaling to 50 and up to 1,000 with paid tiers. The library is positioned for automating the web 'at scale', and example tasks such as exporting follower data to CSV span many items in one run. However, there is no documented batch or bulk-operation API; fanning out work means issuing many individual runs.create calls. Missing for 10: a first-class batch or bulk endpoint, documentation on orchestrating many items or aggregating results, and hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
